no_change_disposition: Retain unchanged policy content at its configured position with new cumulative provenance and evaluation identity; never replace or omit.
invalid_disposition: Preserve the original response and hold compilation if any position is invalid; do not ask the actor for repair.
statistical_priority: Complete process rates, harms and uncertainty
acceptance: Keep strict-population-utility-sum as the registered learning retention signal; process diagnostics do not change historical decisions or establish efficacy.

config_derivation.fixed_scope: Same candidate partitions, node set, reused roster, deterministic sampling, contacts and observe-only boundary behavior.
